producer_report.summary:
The previous-result check in reading.rs now covers only the job the request continues: the retried job (previous_job) and any job the request says it follows up. Jobs the request cites as evidence are no longer checked. Root-cause requests that cite past introspections are therefore accepted and the drain no longer stops on them.

The root cause was that read_for checked every job id in the request text. A new followed_up_ids function reads "follows up job <id>", "follow-up of <id>", "following up on <id>" and similar. A new continued_jobs function picks the retried job plus the followed-up ones from the carried jobs, and read_for passes only those to check_prior_result_and_scope. Evidence jobs still reach the reader's brief with their recorded results. referenced_jobs now carries followed-up jobs first, so the limit of three carried jobs cannot drop one. I added six tests and a CHANGELOG entry. No prompt files changed.

The `cargo test -p athena-core reading` run passed with 55 tests, including the six new ones. The fmt check, clippy on athena-core and `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` also passed. I did not run the full test suite.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test in reading.rs reads a root-cause request that cites two past jobs' introspections as evidence, with no previous_job and no follow-up wording. The reading does not restate those jobs' results and is accepted. Run `cargo test -p athena-core reading`.
criteria_check.evidence: The new test a_root_cause_request_citing_past_jobs_as_evidence_is_accepted passed in `cargo test -p athena-core reading`. It builds a request citing two job ids, passes no attempt, and checks that followed_up_ids and continued_jobs are empty. It then shows a reading that restates nothing is accepted. It also shows the same two jobs, if they were checked as continued, would be refused with 'the previous result'.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test shows that a retry whose reading omits the previous attempt's job id and result is still refused with 'the previous result'. A second test shows that the same retry with a reading that names the previous job is accepted. Run `cargo test -p athena-core reading`.
criteria_check.evidence: The new tests a_retry_whose_reading_omits_the_previous_result_is_refused and a_retry_whose_reading_names_the_previous_job_is_accepted passed. a_retry_is_checked_even_when_the_request_also_cites_evidence also passed.

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows that a request saying it follows up a named job is checked for that job only. A reading that omits the followed-up job is refused. A different job cited in the same request as evidence is not required to be named.
criteria_check.evidence: a_follow_up_request_is_checked_for_the_followed_job_only passed. It shows continued_jobs returns only the followed job. An omitting reading is refused, naming only the followed job and not the evidence job. A reading naming the followed job alone is accepted. follow_up_wording_is_matched_narrowly covers the phrase match.

criteria_check.criterion: read_for passes check_prior_result_and_scope only the retried job and the explicitly followed-up jobs. Evidence-only referenced jobs are still given to the reader in the brief. The doc comments describe this distinction.
criteria_check.evidence: In read_for, priors is now continued_jobs(&request.text, attempt, &referenced_jobs). The ReaderInputs still receive the full referenced_jobs list. Doc comments on followed_up_ids, continued_jobs, referenced_jobs and check_prior_result_and_scope describe the split.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` all pass, including the existing prior-result tests.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran fmt --check and clippy on athena-core only, and both were clean. The existing prior-result tests passed in the reading run (55 passed).

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing that the previous-result check applies only to the continued job and no longer refuses evidence citations.
criteria_check.evidence: A new first entry under Unreleased / Fixed in CHANGELOG.md names the root cause and the new scope. `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` passed.

open_issues: Follow-up detection is a phrase match. It takes only the first id after the phrase, so 'follows up A and B' continues only A. Free-form wording such as 'continuing from <id>' counts as evidence and is not checked.
I did not run the full `cargo test`; Athena runs it.
learnings: read_for needs a live reader to run, so I put the choice of which jobs to check in a pure function, continued_jobs, and tested the accept and refuse paths through it.
RecordId::parse accepts only lowercase ids, so the follow-up matcher lowercases with to_ascii_lowercase, which keeps byte offsets. Phrases are matched case-insensitively; ids must be lowercase.
